title: Boundless recaps Dee Coakley on RTÉ — 'We decided to walk away from the contract'
summary: Boundless (the Irish global-employment platform Dee Coakley founded and led) recaps her RTÉ Radio 1 appearance discussing Incorruptible with Áine Kerr: an early Boundless moment when a big global brand offered a large contract, allegations against that brand's worker treatment in another region made the team uncomfortable with becoming the legal employer, and they walked away — a decision the team then referenced at candidate interviews and offsites as proof the values were real.
blockquote: It wasn't an easy call at the time. But to Dee's point we reaped the benefit of staying true to our values: not only did the team feel proud of the decision at the time but in the years to come, we would mention it at interviews with candidates. At offsites, that decision would come up time and time again as proof that the values were real, not just a page on the website.
attribution_title: Head of Payoneer Workforce Management Europe; former CEO, Boundless
